thread.title: Cirrus Logic stock among lone tech bright spots Monday after analyst says company won Apple AirPod 2 business - MarketWatch

author: Emily Bary
title: Cirrus Logic stock among lone tech bright spots Monday after analyst says company won Apple AirPod 2 business - MarketWatch

organizations.name: marketwatch shares of cirrus logic inc

text: Shares of Cirrus Logic Inc. CRUS, +7.02% are up 8.5% in Monday trading after Susquehanna analyst Christopher Rolland said that the company will have its products in the second-generation Apple Inc. AAPL, -0.56% AirPods. The stock is among the few tech gainers Monday amid general weakness in the sector . Rolland wrote that the AirPod business amounts to "just $50 million" in revenue "but a more serious 50 cent... EPS impact." Cirrus makes chips that factor into audio products. The company didn't immediately respond to MarketWatch's request for comment. Shares are down 39% over the past 12 months, while the S&P 500 SPX, -1.18% has gained 12%.
